findings.eyebrow: At the paper's matched reel-out depower
findings.text: u_dp 0.242: the full model pulls 4.62 kN where the wireframe pulls 2.66 kN at v_a 18.9 m/s (72 to 76% across the swept speeds). It flies at a much higher angle of attack for the same tape.

Inverting the flown force at 5 of 5 near-straight flight bins. The same inversion on the paper's wireframe returns 0.241 ± 0.002, reproducing its published 0.242 — so this is the model moving, not the method.

The flown reel-in force is below everything the full model reaches inside the swept range: 8 of 8 bins sit past the deepest row, which still over-predicts them by 65%. Matching reel-in would need depower past 0.323.

findings.eyebrow: Turn gain, each model at its own match
findings.text: Full model at u_dp 0.315, against 0.235 for the 2019 reel-out flight and 0.184 for the wireframe at its own 0.242. Fitted through the origin.

notes:
Load case

The paper’s REF state: centre of the wind window (elevation 0, azimuth 0, course 90°), no gravity, no radial speed, trim without the tether, as-flown 2019 system (KCU 22 kg). One chain per target apparent speed, 13–25 m s−1: each row’s wind is predicted from the paper’s va/vw table, scaled by the ratio the chain achieved one row back, and re-converged at a corrected wind if it lands more than 0.3 m s−1 off.

Continuation

Each chain is one process holding one Billow structure: every row starts from the previous row’s equilibrium with its tapes in place, and the driver walks the next tape step inside its own loop. Depower walks both ways from the geometry’s built tape (1.90 m, udp 0.278); steering walks up from us 0 at udp 0.242.

Model

VSM quasi-steady trim, 54 panels, base circulation loop, artificial viscosity on with the attached-first guard, moment-matched chordwise load placement, bridle and KCU drag at their own stations. Billow full fidelity on struc_geometry_FEM_full.yaml: 97 inflatable tube beams, 47 cables, 20 pulleys, cross-pattern wrinkling membrane canopy.

Convergence

Coupled residual gate max(0.5 N, 2×10−4 Ft); after a steering step the course rate must also settle. Rows that stagnate above the gate but within 2×10−3 Ft with a steady turn are kept and labelled plateau — the steered limit cycle the wireframe campaign accepts the same way.

Comparison layers

Wireframe: the paper’s _billow9 centre-of-window chains (Billow wireframe, bridle 9×, 45 panels, PSM geometry). Flight: 2019-10-08 EKF, near-straight samples. Coefficients on the EKF’s 19.75 m2; the full model’s VSM normalises by its deformed projected area and is rescaled.

Fixed on the way

The full-model geometry reader charged the KCU’s mass to the canopy and took it off the tubes, so with the flown 22 kg KCU the wing and bridle weighed −8.6 kg. It is fixed; unsteered, gravity-off rows never felt it, steered ones would have.
